extracted.intended_audience: owners/operators of domestic tobacco product establishments, tobacco manufacturers/importers, and public commenters
extracted.subtask_description: Federal Register notice describing FDA information-collection requirements for tobacco product establishment registration and product/ingredient listing under the FD&C Act, the forms and electronic portal to use, proposed updates to forms, estimated respondent burden, and how to submit public comments (including confidential submission procedures).

rubrics_metrics.name: Section 905 annual establishment registration requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 905 of the FD&C Act requires the annual registration of any 'establishment in any State engaged in the manufacture, preparation, compounding, or processing of a tobacco product or tobacco products.' This registration must be completed by December 31 of each year.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA collects the information through the TRLM NG electronic portal and paper Form FDA 3741 (and Form FDA 3741a for those unable to submit online); FDA strongly encourages electronic submission through TRLM NG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required content of establishment registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Owners or operators of each establishment must register: (1) their name; (2) places of business; (3) a list of all tobacco products manufactured by that person; (4) a copy of all labeling and a reference to the authority for the marketing of any tobacco product subject to a tobacco product standard under section 907 or to premarket review under section 910; (5) a copy of all consumer information and other labeling; (6) a representative sampling of advertisements; (7) upon request for good cause, a copy of all advertisements for a particular tobacco product; and (8) upon request, if registrant determined a product is not subject to a section 907 standard, a brief statement of the basis for that determination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These items are collected via TRLM NG or paper forms (Form FDA 3741/3741a). FDA indicates some items may be provided upon request by the Secretary.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ingredient listing requirement (section 904(a)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 904(a)(1) requires each tobacco product manufacturer to submit 'a listing of all ingredients, including tobacco, substances, compounds, and additives that are, as of such date, added by the manufacturer to the tobacco, paper, filter, or other part of each tobacco product by brand and by quantity in each brand and subbrand' (applies only to products manufactured and distributed before June 22, 2009 and still manufactured as of the submission date).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA collects this information through an electronic portal or paper Form FDA 3742 for those who choose not to use the portal. FDA has published a guidance and provides a technical guide, embedded hints, and a web tutorial to assist submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pre-market and additive change notification requirements (section 904(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Under section 904(c) a tobacco product manufacturer must: (1) provide all information required under section 904(a) to FDA at least 90 days prior to delivery for introduction into interstate commerce of a tobacco product not on the market on the date of enactment; (2) advise FDA in writing at least 90 days prior to adding any new tobacco additive or increasing in quantity an existing tobacco additive (except additives designated by FDA by regulation as not carcinogenic or otherwise harmful); and (3) advise FDA in writing at least 60 days prior to eliminating or decreasing an existing additive, or adding or increasing an additive designated by FDA as not harmful.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ingredient submissions may be made electronically through the CTP portal or by mail using Form FDA 3742 for those unable to submit electronically.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submission methods, forms, and assistance
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA collects registration and listing information via the Tobacco Registration and Product Listing Module Next Generation (TRLM NG) electronic portal and through paper forms: Form FDA 3741 (Registration and Product Listing of Tobacco Product Manufacturing Establishments), Form FDA 3741a (current/being merged), Form FDA 3741b (new product list/material file spreadsheet), and Form FDA 3742 (Listing of Ingredients).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: TRLM NG is designed to streamline data entry; FDA strongly encourages electronic submission and provides guidance documents, technical guides, embedded hints, and a web tutorial to assist filers. Links to guidance and downloadable forms are provided in the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Proposed updates to forms and alignment
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA proposes: (1) merging Form FDA 3741a into Form FDA 3741 to create an updated comprehensive Form FDA 3741; (2) restructuring and developing sections for ease of navigation and data input; (3) updating terminology and instructions for clarity; (4) aligning tobacco product categories and subcategories with other FDA tobacco forms; and (5) adding a new product listing spreadsheet (Form FDA 3741b).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA anticipates these updates will increase overall form length but streamline navigation, reduce redundancies, increase user efficiency, and enable more accurate and efficient conveyance of required information.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated annual reporting burden (Establishment Registration Initial — current)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for initial establishment registration (current Form FDA 3741/Form 3741a electronic and paper submissions): 1 respondent metric in table — 75 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 1.6 (96 minutes), total hours = 120.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA bases estimates on experience with the collection, interactions with industry, registration/listing reports, and TRLM NG.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated annual reporting burden (Establishment Registration Initial — updated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for initial establishment registration using the updated Form FDA 3741: 75 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 1.5 (90 minutes), total hours = 113.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This estimate reflects expected burden upon OMB approval of the revision and implementation of the proposed updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated annual reporting burden (Establishment Registration Renewal — current)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for renewal registration (current Form FDA 3741/Form 3741a): 1,003 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 0.17 (10 minutes), total hours = 171.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Based on FDA experience with current registrations and product listings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated annual reporting burden (Establishment Registration Renewal — updated)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for renewal registration using updated Form FDA 3741: 1,003 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 0.33 (20 minutes), total hours = 331.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Estimate reflects expected burden after implementing the updated form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated annual reporting burden (Product Listing Initial — new Form FDA 3741b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for initial product listing using new Form FDA 3741b (Product List and Material File Information Spreadsheet): 75 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 2 (120 minutes), total hours = 150.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA anticipates the new spreadsheet will streamline product listing submissions and subsequent FDA review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated annual reporting burden (Product Listing Renewal — new Form FDA 3741b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for product listing renewals using new Form FDA 3741b: 1,003 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 0.5 (30 minutes), total hours = 502.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Based on FDA's experience with current submissions; reflects burden after proposed updates.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated burden for ingredient listing (Form FDA 3742 — section 904(a)(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for submission of ingredient listings required by section 904(a)(1): 16 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 2 (120 minutes), total hours = 32.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ingredients may be submitted electronically through the CTP portal or by mail using Form FDA 3742.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated burden for ingredient listing updates (Form FDA 3742 — section 904(c))
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden for submissions related to section 904(c) (updates/confirmations of ingredient listings): 37 respondents submitting 10 reports each (370 responses), hours per response = 0.40 (24 minutes), total hours = 148.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA based these estimates on the number of new products authorized over the past 3 years and experience with submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Estimated burden for obtaining a D-U-N-S number
rubrics_metrics.description: Estimated burden to obtain a Dun and Bradstreet D-U-N-S Number: 100 respondents, 1 response each, hours per response = 0.5 (30 minutes), total hours = 50.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA assumes new establishments required to register would obtain a DUNS number and includes this as industry burden.

rubrics_metrics.name: Paperwork Reduction Act (PRA) public comment solicitation topics
rubrics_metrics.description: Under the PRA FDA invites comments on: (1) whether the proposed collection is necessary for proper performance of FDA's functions, including practical utility; (2) the accuracy of FDA's estimate of the burden of the proposed collection, including validity of methodology and assumptions; (3) ways to enhance the quality, utility, and clarity of the information to be collected; and (4) ways to minimize the burden on respondents, including use of automated techniques and other IT.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comments should address these specific topics to assist FDA in its PRA submission to OMB.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to submit comments and procedural requirements
rubrics_metrics.description: Comments (electronic or written) must be submitted by the specified close date; the https://www.regulations.gov portal will accept comments until 11:59 p.m. Eastern Time on the closing date; late/untimely filed comments will not be considered. Submissions must include Docket No. FDA-2024-N-5943. Comments submitted electronically (including attachments) will be posted to Regulations.gov unchanged.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Written/paper submissions may be mailed/hand-delivered to Dockets Management Staff (address provided). Received comments filed timely will be placed in the docket and publicly viewable unless submitted as 'Confidential Submissions' per instructions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential submissions and redaction procedure
rubrics_metrics.description: To submit a comment with confidential information, submit only as a written/paper submission with two copies: one copy containing the confidential information with a heading or cover note 'THIS DOCUMENT CONTAINS CONFIDENTIAL INFORMATION' (will be reviewed by the Agency), and a second copy with the confidential information redacted/blackened for public viewing. Submit both copies to Dockets Management Staff. If you do not wish your name and contact information made public, provide it on the cover sheet (not in the body) and identify it as 'confidential.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Information marked 'confidential' will not be disclosed except in accordance with 21 CFR 10.20 and other applicable disclosure law. FDA references 80 FR 56469 (Sept. 18, 2015) for more information about posting comments to public dockets.

rubrics_metrics.name: Regulated scope — Deeming rule and tobacco product definition (including premium cigars)
rubrics_metrics.description: FDA's tobacco authorities were extended by the 2016 deeming rule to products that meet the statutory definition of 'tobacco product' (except accessories). This includes electronic nicotine delivery systems, cigars, hookah tobacco, pipe tobacco, nicotine gels, dissolvables, and other future tobacco products. The notice also documents a court order vacating application of the deeming rule to premium cigars and provides the court-specified criteria for 'premium cigars' (8 elements: wrapped in whole tobacco leaf; 100% leaf tobacco binder; >=50% long filler tobacco by weight; handmade or hand-rolled; no filter/nontobacco tip/mouthpiece; no characterizing flavor other than tobacco; contain only tobacco, water, vegetable gum with no other ingredients or additives; weigh more than 6 pounds per 1,000 units).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: FDA recognizes the District Court order and is evaluating legal/practical circumstances related to premium cigars; the definition affects which products are subject to chapter IX requirements and therefore to registration/listing obligations.
